head: 29aa3fc6216fdc412801918763ecd5ac321628f1

findings.title: Removed unauthorized error check causes infinite polling on auth failure
findings.trigger: When the query function getPendingInvitations fails with an unauthorized error (e.g., session expired or user lacks permission), the previous logic stopped refetching. After this change, the query continues to refetch every 60 seconds indefinitely.
findings.expected: The query should stop refetching when it encounters an unauthorized error, as the previous code did by returning false from refetchInterval.
findings.actual: refetchInterval is now a constant 60000, so the query keeps polling even on unauthorized errors, resulting in unnecessary repeated requests and potential resource waste.
